scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The result counts ordinary conjugacy classes of units only for the three-level diamond poset, uniformly over finite fields. The b=1 case is classical and not claimed as new. The height-two square-zero comparator is covered by an earlier graphic-Tutte formula; this height-three formula is not implied by it because the radical square is nonzero. Possible equivalent specialized formulas in other orbit-counting literature remain a priority risk. Independent audit and validation are not performed.
title: Conjugacy classes in the units of layered diamond incidence algebras
